Name: Miru's Dwarf Portraits and Characters
Author: Miru36
Description:
[u][size=3]How to use:[/size][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[*]Download and unzip this mod.
[*]Copy the folder "[CP] Miru's Dwarf Portraits and Characters" into your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder.
[/list]

[u][size=3]Config:[/size][/u]
You can edit Config.json or use GMCM to change the settings.

Portrait
[list]
[*]True - Changed portraits
[*]False - No change
[/list]
Character
[list]
[*]True - Changed character sprites
[*]False - No change
[/list]
Emotions
[list]
[*]True - It will be expressive! (Supported mods only)
[*]False - No change of facial expression
[/list]
Miru's Krobus
[list]
[*]True - Change sprites containing Krobus.
[*]False - Vanilla Krobus
[/list]

[u][size=3]Compatible mods:[/size][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9642]The Last Smoluanu - A Dwarf Expansion.[/url]
Created by LemurKat

[u][size=3]Credits:[/size][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14916]Dwarf Portrait Replacement[/url]
I used this mod as a reference for the facial expression differences.

[u][size=3]NOTE:[/size][/u]
Permission is not required for modifications for personal use.
Please contact us if you wish to distribute modified versions of the images.

[u][size=3]My other mods:[/size][/u]

Config.jsonを編集、またはGMCMを使って設定を変更できます。

[*]False - 変更しない
[/list]
Character
[list]
[*]True - キャラクタースプライトを変更

[/list]
Emotions
[list]
[*]True - 表情豊かになる！（対応するMODのみ）

[/list]
Miru's Krobus
[list]

[/list]
